name: Gazprom Neft
note: Rating note: the Gazprom Group owns about 96% of Gazprom Neft (AK&M, corroborated by Reuters via GB&F), and the Russian state is Gazprom's ultimate controlling party with over 50% (Gazprom IFRS note); Russia has been at war with Ukraine since February 2022 (UN OHCHR). Propose severe, mirroring the existing Gazprom rating (a state directly tied to ongoing severe abuses controls the sponsor). Club sponsor of SKA (Stavka TV lists Gazprom Neft and its G-Drive brand among СКА's sponsors), and it has owned 99.99% of the SKA hockey club since May 2026 (Interfax, 15 May 2026). Also general partner of HC Avangard (G-Drive Arena naming); NIS subsidiary sanctioned in 2025.
